visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with straight blonde hair and bangs, wearing a white sweatshirt, sits in a room with indoor lighting. She holds a large blue bag of OREO Mega Stuf cookies, gesturing with her left hand while speaking directly to the camera. Background objects include a professional microphone on an arm, a computer monitor, and various items on shelves. (2) The camera focuses on the blue Oreo bag as she brings it closer. A pink heart-shaped graphic animation briefly appears over the product. She continues talking with an expressive facial expression. (3) She proceeds to open the blue plastic packaging, pulling out a clear plastic tray that contains multiple rows of dark chocolate sandwich cookies with a very thick white cream layer. (4) She selects one cookie and holds it very close to the camera lens, rotating it slowly to show the depth of the white cream filling from different angles. She positions it next to her face to emphasize its size. (5) She takes a deliberate bite of the cookie, showing the bitten interior to the camera while chewing and looking happy. (6) She twists the cookie apart, holding the two halves up—one with a large mound of white cream and the other a plain chocolate wafer—as she concludes her presentation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 不知道有多少人跟我一樣喜歡吃這個oreo的那個糖霜. (2) [Subtitle]: 我小時候印象中就有看過那個雙倍的那個白色oreo糖霜. (3) [Subtitle]: 但我在台灣怎樣都找都找不到不知道為什麼. (4) [Subtitle]: 我就印象中就是真的有但是台灣就只有那個什麼減糖的oreo. (5) [Subtitle]: 我就不喜歡這減糖就是要多一點白色的. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後這次去加拿大的時候想到難得來這邊我就來找找看. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後特別跑去超市去找我就看到雙倍糖霜oreo耶超開心的. (8) [Subtitle]: 同時在它旁邊看到這個mega oreo巨大的糖霜耶. (9) [Subtitle]: 給大家看一下到底有多誇張. (10) [Subtitle]: 噔噔噔噔噔啊. (11) [Subtitle]: 應該要買一個一般的oreo跟它比較才會讓大家知道到底差在哪裡. (12) [Subtitle]: 但是一般的我吃起來就是不夠爽所以給大家看一下. (13) [Subtitle]: 這是巨大的比雙倍oreo還要再更多的糖霜就是這樣. (14) [Subtitle]: 咬下去這個糖霜這個量真的很多哎. (15) [Subtitle]: 有人跟我一樣吃oreo會先把糖霜吃完再把餅乾吃掉或是餅乾直接給其他人的人嗎.

(3) The distinct rustling and crinkling of plastic packaging is heard clearly over the music as the speaker starts to open the bag. (4) A high-pitched melodic 'ding' or sparkle effect plays when she showcases the thick cream of the Oreo to the camera. The speaker's voice exhibits high arousal and positive valence. (6) The BGM continues until the end, with the speaker asking a final question in a friendly, conversational tone with frequent rising intonations.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator is sharing her excitement about finding 'Mega Stuf' Oreos in Canada, a product she couldn't find in Taiwan. She showcases the extreme thickness of the cream to her audience and asks about their preferred way of eating Oreos to drive social media engagement.
